1:1.note: Plus "son of Nun, servant of the LORD" and "in battle".

1:4.note: Proleptic object pronoun added; "went up" rendered "went".

4:16.note: "Not one remained" rendered "no man escaped alive".

4:17.note: Jael rendered Anael; minus "house"; plus copula.

5:27.note: Minus repeated "between her feet he bowed, fell".

12:11.note: "from Zebulun" for the Zebulunite; second "and he judged Israel" not rendered.
